name: agy-boost
description: Native, ultra-fast modding platform for Google Antigravity (Go + Pure TS + Wasm).

scripts.build:client: pnpm --dir src/client run build && go run ./scripts/build.go copy-runtime
scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:go
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:client && go run ./scripts/build.go all
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck:go && pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run typecheck:contracts
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:go
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run lint:ts:fix && go run ./scripts/build.go format
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run typecheck && go test -short ./src/... && pnpm run test:client
scripts.test:client: pnpm run build:client && node --import ./tests/harness/register-loader.mjs --test tests/core/*.test.ts tests/ui/*.test.ts tests/ci/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:client && node tests/e2e/test_flexbox_invariant.mjs && node tests/e2e/test_full_mod_lifecycle.mjs
scripts.test:all: pnpm run typecheck && go test -v ./src/... && pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:fast
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:all && pnpm run build
